environment.receiver: Go test receiver, HMAC verified, 204, no artificial delay; request logging enabled
environment.http: Python urllib, new connections; API loopback; outgoing keepalive disabled; no retries by load generator

measurement_notes: Single run per concurrency; not a production SLO or maximum capacity.
Generator, receiver, dispatcher and sampler share one machine; caches and ambient load uncontrolled.
CPU percentages use one core=100%; RSS/queue peaks sampled, not absolute peaks.
Read-only SQLite queue polling every 0.1s adds observer load; periodic scrapes are additional load.
Go worker polls every 0.1s and sends one event per step; throughput includes this scheduling policy.
Drain completion sampled every 0.1s; end-to-end latency uses wall-clock milliseconds from SQLite.
Disk reports apparent size and st_blocks allocation, not write amplification nor complete Btrfs physical accounting.
Publication throughput is a short burst rate; sustained publication capacity not measured.
Scrapes after drain read a retained dataset; no inference about much larger datasets.

cases.assertions: all publications accepted; one finalized HTTP 204 attempt per event; integrity/FK valid
all publications accepted; one finalized HTTP 204 attempt per event; integrity/FK valid
